group_by.label: Patient
group_by.note: Phases of the same patient are not independent; do not read them as separate patients.

axes.label: Texture
axes.guide: Only texture decides here; brightness has its own axis. GLCM and Wavelet compare the synthetic slice with the variation among the real CTs, in IQR: within ±1 IQR is approved, 1 to 2 IQR asks for review, beyond 2 IQR is rejected. NEx compares the synthetic slice with its own original: more than 1 IQR of difference asks for review but never rejects on its own. The most severe technique sets the result.

axes.label: Brightness
axes.guide: Only brightness decides here; texture is not used. GLCM and Wavelet each classify the pair on their own and the most severe one sets the brightness verdict. In GLCM the worse of |Δμ| and Sat31 decides: |Δμ| limits are 1 and 2 IQR of the real lung means, and more than 15% of lung pixels at the brightest tone rejects directly. Wavelet LL is reviewed beyond 1 IQR and rejected beyond 2 IQR. Density is context only and does not decide.

axes.label: Noise
axes.guide: Noise is the pixel-to-pixel fluctuation that is not anatomy, measured two ways; the worst reading decides the slice. (a) NPS in the lung: quantity and grain size in the smoothest 32 × 32 px lung regions, measured on the same regions as the original, in IQR of the real CTs; a difference only counts when it passes the limit and its bootstrap interval excludes zero. (b) Air spots: the air outside the body is smooth in the original, so any spot there was invented by the generator; up to 0.5% of the air is approved, up to 2% asks for review, above is rejected (policy limits, not clinical ones). If fewer than 4 lung regions fit, the lung is inconclusive and the slice is at least reviewed.

metrics.label: GLCM Δμ
metrics.description: How far the mean lung tone of the synthetic slice moved from the real one, on the 32-tone GLCM scale.

metrics.label: GLCM Sat31
metrics.description: Percent of lung pixels at the brightest GLCM tone (31); catches washed-out images even when Δμ is small.

metrics.label: Wavelet LL
metrics.description: Local 4×4 px mean (Wavelet LL band): follows brightness and ignores detail; catches bright slices that Δμ misses.

metrics.label: GLCM contrast
metrics.description: How much the tone changes between neighbouring pixels; a drop suggests smoothing or loss of high frequency.

metrics.label: GLCM energy
metrics.description: Uniformity of neighbouring tone pairs; can rise when the image gets smoother.

metrics.label: Wavelet 2 px
metrics.description: Amount of detail at the fine scale (~2 px): thin edges, noise, small vessels.

metrics.label: Wavelet 4 px
metrics.description: Amount of detail at the coarse scale (~4 px): medium vessels, septa.

metrics.label: Wavelet entropy
metrics.description: Variation and complexity of the distribution of detail across scales.

metrics.label: NEx
metrics.description: Excess or lack of structure near the resolution limit, compared with the slice's own original; more than 1 IQR of difference asks for review.

metrics.label: NPS quantity
metrics.description: Total strength of the local pixel fluctuation in the lung; more quantity means a more intense noise map.

metrics.label: NPS grain size
metrics.description: Width of the noise patterns: positive means finer grain, negative means coarser grain.

metrics.label: NPS wide patterns
metrics.description: Share of the noise in slow, wide patterns.

metrics.label: NPS fine grain
metrics.description: Share of the noise in fast, small patterns (fine grain).

metrics.label: Air spots
metrics.description: Percent of the air outside the body with spots stronger than 3× the CT's natural noise, which the original does not have.

inspectors.label: Spectrum
inspectors.description: Radial power spectrum inside the lung ROI; the band is P5–P95 of the real slices. Display only.

inspectors.label: GLCM
inspectors.description: Co-occurrence of neighbouring tones on the 32-tone scale, real and synthetic.

inspectors.label: NEx
inspectors.description: Near-Nyquist excess of the slice against the P5–P95 band of the real slices.

inspectors.label: NEx windows
inspectors.description: NEx of each 32 px lung window, real and synthetic.

inspectors.label: Wavelet
inspectors.description: Detail energy per wavelet level and band, real and synthetic.

choices.label: Real × synthetic (Δμ)
choices.description: Images in the same display window; the title shows the lung mean and Δμ.

choices.label: Density · pixels outside the real range
choices.description: Red: pixels above the real lung P99; blue: below P1. This is what density counts.

choices.label: Local brightness (Wavelet LL)
choices.description: Wavelet LL band: the image as a 4×4 px local mean, i.e. brightness only, without texture.

choices.label: Wavelet · fine detail
choices.description: Energy of the finest wavelet level (~2 px), pixel by pixel, inside the lung mask and over the whole CT (dark = smooth, yellow = much detail). Same scale in every column: blurring erases the bright dots.

choices.label: Wavelet · coarse detail
choices.description: Energy of the coarse wavelet level (~4 px), pixel by pixel, inside the lung mask and over the whole CT (dark = smooth, yellow = much detail). Same scale in every column.

choices.label: GLCM · contrast
choices.description: Tone difference between each pixel and its neighbours, on the 32-tone GLCM scale (5×5 px local mean).

inspectors.label: Regional map
inspectors.description: Lung blocks of 16 px coloured by what changed; the verdict layer exists only when compared.

inspectors.label: Noise
inspectors.description: NPS in the lung regions and the air-spot test for this slice.

result.label: Systematic deviation: NEx tends to be higher

items.head: steps: 35 é o ponto.
items.body: Sozinho (com eta 0) dá +7,8%. Em cima de eta e conditioning o efeito é bem maior: Matheus foi de +7,9% para +16,1% ao trocar 25 por 35. Com 45 piora (Wavelet grossa, LL e correlação do mapa caem) e com 50 quase nada muda.

items.head: eta: o parâmetro mais confiável.
items.body: De 0 a 0,4 a melhora quase só sobe. Ganha mais em energia GLCM, entropia, LL e NEx. Contraste e Wavelet fina saturam perto de +20% e +17%. Risco: o caso ...1-047 oscila entre NEx alto e normal conforme o eta. Ainda não se testou acima de 0,4.

items.head: conditioning_noise_scale: ajuda, mas só depois de eta e steps.
items.body: Com eta 0 e 35 passos, 1,10 piorou o NEx (extremos nos dois sentidos) e foi descartado. Com eta 0,2 e 25 passos, subiu a cada degrau (+4,8% → +6,0% com 1,10 → +7,9% com 1,25). Com 35 passos, de 1,25 para 1,40 foi +16,1% → +18,5%. Em eta 0,3 a 0,35 a diferença entre cond 1,0 e 1,4 é de uns 5 pontos. Ainda não se testou 1,5 (limite do espaço).

items.head: noise_level: não é alavanca.
items.body: 10 deu +4,4% e 50 piorou (1 rejeição, 1 par suspeito). Fica em 1.

items.head: Casos que nenhum controle permitido resolve:
items.body: ...1-033 (borrado), ...1-59 (escuro), ...1-031, ...1-65, ...1-072. Mesmo na melhor atual a textura aprova 30 de 37. Se a meta for esses cortes, parâmetro de amostragem não basta.

items.head: Interação.
items.body: Os efeitos de conditioning e steps dependem do eta e dos passos atuais; o que falha isolado pode funcionar em cima da melhor atual.
eta 0,4 → 0,5, mantendo conditioning 1,4: LL e NEx vinham subindo com o eta. Vigiar Wavelet entropia (já recuou 0,5 ponto de 0,3 para 0,4) e o NEx alto no 1-047.
conditioning_noise_scale 1,4 → 1,5: foi o maior ganho depois de steps. É o limite do espaço; esperar menos retorno.
Só depois, steps entre 30 e 40, porque o efeito depende dos outros dois.
